title: Implement the SiteFlow operator console from the Operations Ledger design reference

repo_state.implementation_baseline: Empty/minimal repository: no package.json, source tree, lockfile, or existing frontend conventions were found in the tracked workspace listing.
repo_state.git_state: Repository root is not currently a Git repository, so collision safety is based on file ownership rather than Git metadata.

wave_1_findings.architecture: Use design-ref as source of truth. Routes are /projects, /projects/:id, /deployments/:id, /projects/:id/release/:channel, and /projects/:id/rollback/:channel. Domain state follows source_event -> build_job -> artifact -> deployment -> release_channel/preview -> route_revision/audit_event.
wave_1_findings.implementation: Scaffold a TypeScript React/Vite console with shared shell, panels, tables, status pills, timelines, logs/evidence, safety checks, audit forms, fixture-backed API boundary, Vitest, and Playwright.
wave_1_findings.integration: Define DB-backed read models for projects, deployments, channels, artifacts, route revisions, logs, and audit. Include polling/SSE boundaries and explicit loading, error, and empty states.
wave_1_findings.risk: Mitigate secret leakage, destructive promote/rollback, stale route/CDN states, rollback eligibility, dense responsive/a11y issues, missing tests, and file collision risk.

visual_rules: Compact operations workspace, not a marketing landing page.
Use OKLCH design tokens, Inter, JetBrains Mono, 4-8px radii, stable tables, and reduced-motion CSS.
Expose production state, build/artifact evidence, route health, safety checks, audit reasons, and actor history.
Never show secret values in settings, logs, manifests, fixtures, route config, or copied evidence.

complexity.rationale: The repository needs first-time frontend scaffolding plus multiple route-level operational workflows, typed fixture contracts, destructive-action safeguards, and cross-page verification.

waves.description: Create the frontend foundation, tokenized shell, shared UI primitives, and route handoff points.
Define fixture-backed SiteFlow read models and API/state contracts consumed by all route features.
Implement the three independent operator workflows against the shared contracts.
Harden cross-page verification, responsive checks, and risk-focused regression coverage.

tasks.title: Scaffold React/Vite console, tokens, shell, and shared UI primitives
Define fixture-backed API boundary and SiteFlow state contracts
Implement project inventory and project detail views
Implement deployment evidence, lineage, and log views
Implement release promotion and rollback safeguards
Harden verification, responsive behavior, a11y, and security regressions

cross_task_checks: All five target routes render through the shared shell without a marketing or landing screen.
Rendered DOM and fixture exports contain no raw secret canary values.
Promotion and rollback actions remain disabled until safety checks pass and an audit reason is present.
Deployment views do not label a deployment routable before verified artifact and applied route revision evidence is present.
Tables, lineage chains, logs, and sticky action bars remain usable at 375px, 768px, and 1280px widths.
Reduced-motion media query is present and effective.

quality_floor.unit_and_component_tests: Core public helpers, feature routes, safety guards, redaction, and rendered states covered with Vitest/Testing Library.
quality_floor.e2e_tests: Playwright smoke coverage across all target routes and responsive widths.
quality_floor.build: TypeScript and Vite production build pass.

notes: No existing source implementation or Git metadata was found, so all source files are new.
TASK-001 owns root setup, shell, styles, shared UI, and test setup. It may create three feature route placeholder modules only to keep the scaffold buildable.

After TASK-001, feature work is isolated by directory: projects, deployments, and release. The three wave 3 tasks can run in parallel if they do not edit root config, shell, shared UI, domain, or API files.
TASK-006 owns only Playwright and cross-page test files. It should not rewrite feature implementation files except for narrowly scoped fixes required by failing tests.
Because the root is not a Git repository, future executors should avoid broad staging assumptions and should not use git add . if a repository is initialized later.

criteria: Every task file includes a non-empty read_first list.
Every task file includes convergence.criteria with grep- or command-verifiable outcomes.
Task count is six or fewer and grouped by feature, not by individual file.
Dependencies are limited to scaffold, shared API contracts, and final verification.
File ownership is explicit and parallel wave tasks are isolated by feature directory.

requirements_coverage.reason: The six mandatory task areas are represented and mapped to the requested routes, design reference, and Wave 1 risk findings.

task_quality.reason: Tasks are feature-level, have exact ownership, concrete actions, tests, and convergence criteria.

dependency_correctness.reason: Only scaffold, API contracts, and final verification are sequential. Feature tasks are parallel after shared contracts exist.

estimation_accuracy.reason: Estimates are reasonable for first implementation work, but package installation and UI polish may vary because the repository has no baseline.

collision_safety.reason: Ownership separates root scaffold, shared contracts, feature folders, and test hardening. Known scaffold placeholders are explicitly called out as handoffs.
